title: Proteus app capability manifest
description: Declarative capability contract for launcher / EnvGate gating. Spec: docs/proteus/APPLICATIONS.md.

id.description: Stable manifest id (often matches a desktop id stem).

desktopIds.description: Desktop entry ids to match (with or without .desktop).

match.description: Optional case-insensitive regex against id/name/genericName/exec when desktopIds miss.

requires.description: Capabilities that must all be present (Hardware.has).

requiresAny.description: At least one of these capabilities must be present.

permissions.description: User grants required via Permissions.qml (allow only; ask/deny block). Fail-open until store ready.

reason.description: Human string shown when search surfaces a blocked app.

prefers.description: Soft capability hints — Beacon subtitle + search boost; never blocks.

postures.description: Hard posture allow-list (SessionPosture). Empty = any posture.

device_classes.description: Hard device-class allow-list (Hardware.deviceClass). Empty = any class.

adapts.description: UI-shaping hints (EnvGate profile + Beacon hint + PROTEUS_ADAPT_* launch env). Never blocks availability.

input.description: Preferred input modes; resolver picks first present via Hardware.has (remote: CEC/IR/lirc or Bluetooth HID probe or PROTEUS_REMOTE_PROBE stub).

nav.description: Nav density facets; resolver uses console→sparse else dense when listed.

panes.description: Pane density facets; EnvGate resolves via FocusMode.paneDensity (soft hint + launch env for apps; Settings hard-hides non-allowlisted panes when minimal).
